purpose: Stage 2 attribution reporting only, not method selection or replacement length gates
margin_formula: max(abs(reference_seed0-reference_seed1), floor); relative Chamfer spread divided by reference-pair mean
readers: motion and hand-velocity metrics: stride 6 primary; others: mean of strides 2 and 6; Chamfer: symmetric p90
reference_choice: fixed adopted M3D seed0/1 full-split 100k endpoints, chosen before any Stage 2 registration
